pageDescription: Rujira offers a unified omnichain DeFi ecosystem for humans and machines. Trade and borrow native BTC, ETH, SOL and other assets with a seamless CEX-like experience, fully on-chain and open-source. From a BTC-backed stablecoin to an all-inclusive DeFi suite, Rujira is building the infrastructure for the next wave of economic freedom.

purposeSparkLead: Crypto has forgotten why it started.
purposeSparkParagraph1: It started with Bitcoin, a new kind of money beyond the control of banks and governments.
purposeSparkParagraph2: It stood for transparency, decentralization, fairness, and freedom, where anyone could access and move value freely without paying the price of constant currency devaluation.
purposeDriftLead: Over time, we slowly lost our way.
purposeDriftParagraph1: Somewhere along the way, we traded principles for convenience and lost sight of what made crypto so promising.
purposeDriftParagraph2: We handed our Bitcoin to centralized platforms, built black-box "CeDeFi" apps that relied on trust, and created a fragmented system. Over time, insiders, scammers, and centralized entities drained value from the people this space was meant to empower.
purposeReturnLead: Rujira brings crypto back to its roots.
purposeReturnParagraph1: It's time for a sustainable financial system that gives everyone the same opportunities.
purposeReturnParagraph2: A system open to all, where the rules are transparent and verifiably applied equally to everyone.
purposeReturnParagraph3: Built on transparency, resilience, and true community ownership.
purposeConnectionLead: One transparent network for every chain
purposeConnectionParagraph1: Rujira brings major blockchains and native assets together in one open network built for transparency and freedom.
purposeConnectionParagraph2: It's open-source, permissionless, and fully omnichain.
purposeStandardLead: Equal access becomes the new standard.
purposeStandardParagraph1: We are designing a system where fairness, transparency, and opportunity aren't optional, they are built in.
purposeStandardParagraph2: This is the financial foundation crypto was meant to be.
builtDifferentCopy1: Rujira was created to bring fairness back to finance.
builtDifferentCopy2: Every part of the experience works together to make finance open, transparent, and equal for everyone.

productsTitle: A System Built to Work in Harmony
productsCopy1: Rujira brings all the products you need into one place where everything works together for you.
productsCopy2: No more jumping between apps or chains, just a simple way to make DeFi feel easy.
productsRoadmapCopy: Learn what we are working on next
securedAssetsTitle: Native assets, built to stay safe
securedAssetsBody1: Rujira lets you trade, borrow, and earn with native assets like BTC and ETH across chains without wrapped tokens or third party bridges thanks to THORChain's Secured Assets.
securedAssetsBody2: Your assets stay backed 1:1 through THORChain’s decentralized vaults, giving you a transparent path back to the original asset while keeping full control in your hands.
enshrinedOraclesBody1: Rujira uses robust price feeds to help protect your assets across the product suite.
enshrinedOraclesBody2: Prices are checked across multiple sources to help create fair markets, reliable liquidations, and transparent access for everyone.
rujiTokenSubtitle: Built for lasting growth, not speculation.
rujiTokenBody: RUJI shares real revenue from across Rujira's apps and rewards you in USDC, creating a sustainable system where growth benefits everyone.
